purpose.domain_detail: Claims interest payment posting to CLAS-IC online indexed file; carrier-level claim interest records processed in batch with printed report
purpose.summary: EL341CI reads a sequential file of claim interest payment records (carrier, claim number, cert number, check number, check date, check amount) and posts them to an indexed CLAS-IC online file (ELTRLR). It produces a printed report showing claims posted per carrier with totals and reinsurance subtotals, and tracks not-found errors.

notable_features: INDEXED file with DYNAMIC access and FILE STATUS
COPY statements for FD definitions (ELCTRLR, ELCDTEFD, ELCPRTFD, ELCFCHFD)
COMP-3 group-level aggregate area with multiple accumulators
Non-standard level numbers (12, 16, 20) in group items
VMOD=2.001 version marker in working storage
